blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能夠識別並說明本指南所引用的關鍵法規與指引文件（ICH、FDA、EU GMP、WHO等）的用途與重要性。
blocks.en: Be able to identify and explain the purpose and importance of the key regulations and guidelines cited in this guide (ICH, FDA, EU GMP, WHO, etc.).

blocks.zh: 掌握 ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.6 詞彙表中所有縮寫的全稱與中文意義。
blocks.en: Know the full name and meaning of every abbreviation in the ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.6 glossary.

blocks.zh: 深度理解 Closed System（密閉系統）、Open System（開放式系統）、Axenic State（純淨狀態）、Bioburden-Free（無微生物負荷）等核心定義。
blocks.en: Gain a deep understanding of core definitions such as Closed System, Open System, Axenic State and Bioburden-Free.

blocks.zh: 能夠解釋 CQA、CPP、BSL、SIP、CIP、RABS 等術語在生物製藥廠房設計與 GMP 合規中的實務意義。
blocks.en: Be able to explain the practical meaning of terms such as CQA, CPP, BSL, SIP, CIP and RABS for biopharmaceutical facility design and GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: 利用快速參考摘要表，作為日常 GMP 術語查閱工具。
blocks.en: Use the quick-reference summary table as an everyday GMP terminology lookup tool.

blocks.zh: 原文內容 — Key Regulatory References
blocks.en: Original Text — Key Regulatory References

blocks.zh: 導師解析 — 核心法規文件的重要性
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis — Why the Core Regulatory Documents Matter

blocks.zh: ICH Q7/Q7A — API GMP 準則
blocks.en: ICH Q7/Q7A — GMP for APIs

blocks.zh: 本指引規範了活性醫藥成分（API）的 GMP 要求，是全球藥廠共同遵守的基準。對生物製藥而言，雖然 API 多為大分子蛋白質，但此指引確立了生產環境控制、設備確效、批次記錄等核心概念，為後續生物製藥特定指引（如 ICH Q11）奠定基礎。
blocks.en: This guideline sets out GMP requirements for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and is the common baseline followed by manufacturers worldwide. Although biopharmaceutical APIs are mostly large-molecule proteins, the guideline establishes core concepts such as production environment control, equipment qualification and batch records, which underpin later biotech-specific guidelines such as ICH Q11.

blocks.zh: ICH Q11 — 原料藥開發與製造
blocks.en: ICH Q11 — Development and Manufacture of Drug Substances

blocks.zh: Q11 是 Q7 的延伸，專門針對「生技／生物製品」的原料藥（drug substance）開發，包括細胞培養、發酵、純化等程序。此指引要求廠商建立設計空間（Design Space）並說明工藝開發的科學依據，與 ISPE Vol.6 的設施設計邏輯緊密連動。
blocks.en: Q11 extends Q7 and addresses the development of biotechnological/biological drug substances, including cell culture, fermentation and purification. It expects manufacturers to establish a Design Space and explain the scientific rationale for process development, which is closely linked to the facility design logic of ISPE Vol.6.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211 — FDA 完成劑型 GMP
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 — FDA GMP for Finished Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211 是 FDA 對完成劑型藥品（finished pharmaceuticals）的核心法規要求，涵蓋廠房設計、設備、人員、生產與製程控制、品管等全面要求。生物製藥廠若打算在美國銷售產品，必須確保所有設施設計與操作程序符合 Part 211 的最低要求。重點：Part 211 是法規底線，而 ISPE 指引是最佳實務；在合規上，法規永遠優先。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 is the FDA's core regulation for finished pharmaceuticals, covering facility design, equipment, personnel, production and process controls, quality control and more. A biopharmaceutical plant that intends to sell product in the US must ensure that all facility designs and operating procedures meet the minimum requirements of Part 211. Key point: Part 211 is the regulatory floor, whereas ISPE guidance is best practice; for compliance purposes, the regulation always takes precedence.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 — 品質風險管理（QRM）
blocks.en: ICH Q9 — Quality Risk Management (QRM)

blocks.zh: Q9 建立了製藥業通用的風險管理框架，包括 FMEA（失效模式效應分析）、HACCP（危害分析重要管制點）等工具。ISPE Vol.6 全書的設施設計決策（密閉系統、環境分級、HVAC 設計等）均以 QRM 為核心依據，若不理解 Q9，就無法理解為何某些空間需要更嚴格的環境控制。
blocks.en: Q9 establishes a general risk management framework for the pharmaceutical industry, including tools such as FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points). The facility design decisions throughout ISPE Vol.6 (closed systems, environmental classification, HVAC design and so on) are all grounded in QRM; without understanding Q9, it is impossible to understand why some spaces require stricter environmental control.

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規文件的層次關係
blocks.en: Analogy: The Hierarchy of Regulatory Documents

blocks.zh: 把這些文件想像成建築法規的體系：ICH Q7/Q11 是「建築法規總則」（適用所有建築），21 CFR Part 211 是「消防安全強制規範」（必須遵守），ICH Q9 是「風險評估工具手冊」，而 ISPE Vol.6 則是「高端實驗室建築設計最佳實務指南」。後者告訴你怎麼蓋得最好，但前者告訴你最低必須做到什麼。
blocks.en: Think of these documents as a system of building codes: ICH Q7/Q11 are the "general building code" (applicable to all buildings), 21 CFR Part 211 is the "mandatory fire safety code" (must be followed), ICH Q9 is the "risk assessment toolbook", and ISPE Vol.6 is the "best-practice guide to designing a high-end laboratory building". The latter tells you how to build it best, but the former tell you the minimum you must achieve.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2)（製藥開發）與 ICH Q9（品質風險管理）在設施設計決策中各自扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: What roles do ICH Q8(R2) (Pharmaceutical Development) and ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) each play in facility design decisions?

blocks.zh: 若一家生物製藥廠同時申請 FDA（美國）和 EMA（歐盟）許可，需要同時遵守 21 CFR Part 211 和哪個歐盟文件？
blocks.en: If a biopharmaceutical plant applies for approval from both the FDA (US) and the EMA (EU), which EU document must it comply with in addition to 21 CFR Part 211?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 — ISPE, EU GMP, WHO & Biosafety References
blocks.en: Original Text — ISPE, EU GMP, WHO & Biosafety References

blocks.zh: 導師解析 — ISPE、EU GMP、WHO 與生物安全文件
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis — ISPE, EU GMP, WHO and Biosafety Documents

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.5（C&Q）— 確效的語言基礎
blocks.en: ISPE Vol.5 (C&Q) — The Language Foundation of Qualification

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.6 全書中所有關於系統確效的分類（如 Direct Impact / No Impact，後演變為 QRM Verification）均源自 Vol.5。因此，當 Vol.6 描述「封閉系統不是影響要項（Critical Aspect）」，背後的判定邏輯就是 Vol.5 C&Q 的框架。CDMO 工程師必須將兩者搭配閱讀。
blocks.en: All the system classifications in ISPE Vol.6 relating to qualification (such as Direct Impact / No Impact, later evolved into QRM verification) originate from Vol.5. So when Vol.6 describes a closed system as not a Critical Aspect, the underlying decision logic is the framework of Vol.5 C&Q. CDMO engineers must read the two together.

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 2 — 生物製品製造的歐盟專屬要求
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 2 — EU-Specific Requirements for Manufacture of Biological Products

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 2 專門規範生物製品（包括細胞培養、發酵、血液製品、單株抗體等）的製造要求，是歐盟市場准入的必要條件。此附錄的「草案版」在本書出版時已引入「製程密閉度」和「環境控制策略」的概念，直接影響了 ISPE Vol.6 的設施設計建議。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 2 specifically governs the manufacture of biological products (including cell culture, fermentation, blood products, monoclonal antibodies and so on) and is a prerequisite for access to the EU market. The draft version of this annex, at the time this book was published, had already introduced the concepts of "degree of process closure" and "environmental control strategy", which directly influenced the facility design recommendations of ISPE Vol.6.

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 — 無菌製品的標準
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 — Standards for Sterile Products

blocks.zh: Annex 1 是全球無菌製造設施的「聖經」，規定了 A/B/C/D 四個環境等級（Grade A/B/C/D）、浮游菌、沉降菌、接觸碟等環境監測標準。ISPE Vol.6 的環境分級章節與 Annex 1 緊密對應，兩者必須同時參照。
blocks.en: Annex 1 is the "bible" of sterile manufacturing facilities worldwide. It defines the four environmental grades (Grade A/B/C/D) and the environmental monitoring standards for airborne particles, settle plates, contact plates and so on. The environmental classification chapter of ISPE Vol.6 corresponds closely to Annex 1, and the two must be consulted together.

blocks.zh: NIH/CDC 生物安全指引 — BSL 等級的法源依據
blocks.en: NIH/CDC Biosafety Guidelines — The Legal Basis for BSL Levels

blocks.zh: NIH Guidelines 和 CDC/NIH 聯合出版的《Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)》是定義 BSL 1-4 生物安全等級的權威文件。ISPE Vol.6 的圍堵策略（Containment Strategy）和設施設計均依賴這些指引來確定微生物的危害等級，以決定所需的物理圍堵措施。若處理 BSL-2 以上的微生物，廠房設計必須符合相應圍堵要求，這不只是 GMP，更是生物安全法律義務。
blocks.en: The NIH Guidelines and the jointly published CDC/NIH publication Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL) are the authoritative documents that define Biosafety Levels BSL 1-4. The containment strategy and facility design in ISPE Vol.6 rely on these guidelines to determine the hazard level of the microorganisms and hence the physical containment measures required. If microorganisms of BSL-2 or above are handled, the facility design must meet the corresponding containment requirements; this is not just GMP but a legal biosafety obligation.

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1 — 潔淨室空氣分級標準
blocks.en: ISO 14644-1 — Cleanroom Air Classification Standard

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1 以科學化的粒子計數方式定義 ISO Class 1-9，是歐美日藥廠環境監測的通用語言。FDA 採用 ISO 5/7/8 對應其傳統的 Class 100/10,000/100,000；EU GMP 則採用 Grade A/B/C/D 但同樣參照 ISO 標準測試方法。ISPE Vol.6 的環境章節以 ISO 14644 為基礎，橋接兩套體系。
blocks.en: ISO 14644-1 defines ISO Class 1-9 through scientific particle counting and is the common language of environmental monitoring in US, European and Japanese pharmaceutical plants. The FDA uses ISO 5/7/8 as equivalents of its traditional Class 100/10,000/100,000; EU GMP uses Grade A/B/C/D but likewise refers to ISO test methods. The environmental chapter of ISPE Vol.6 is based on ISO 14644 and bridges the two systems.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 雙向申請場景
blocks.en: Practical Application — CDMO Dual-Market Filing Scenario

blocks.zh: 一家台灣 CDMO 同時為美國客戶（FDA 監管）和歐盟客戶（EMA 監管）生產生物製劑。需同時遵守：21 CFR Part 211（FDA）、EU GMP Annex 1 & 2（EMA）、ISO 14644-1（環境分級）、ICH Q9/Q10（品質體系）、NIH/CDC 生物安全指引（BSL 評估）。本附錄的參考文獻清單，就是建立多市場合規矩陣的起點。
blocks.en: A Taiwanese CDMO manufactures biologics for both US customers (FDA-regulated) and EU customers (EMA-regulated). It must comply with all of the following: 21 CFR Part 211 (FDA), EU GMP Annex 1 & 2 (EMA), ISO 14644-1 (environmental classification), ICH Q9/Q10 (quality system) and NIH/CDC biosafety guidelines (BSL assessment). The reference list in this appendix is the starting point for building a multi-market compliance matrix.

blocks.zh: 導師解析 — 關鍵縮寫深入說明
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis — Key Abbreviations Explained

blocks.zh: BSL（生物安全等級）— 圍堵設計的起點
blocks.en: BSL (Biosafety Level) — The Starting Point of Containment Design

blocks.zh: BSL 1-4 是依據微生物對人體的危害程度分級，決定廠房圍堵等級的關鍵輸入：
blocks.en: BSL 1-4 classify microorganisms by the hazard they pose to humans and are the key input for determining the containment level of a facility:

blocks.zh: BSL-1：低危害，標準微生物操作（一般實驗室）
blocks.en: BSL-1: low hazard, standard microbiological practices (general laboratory)

blocks.zh: BSL-2：中度危害（多數生物製藥細胞株，如 CHO、大腸桿菌），需負壓、高壓滅菌器、BSC
blocks.en: BSL-2: moderate hazard (most biopharmaceutical cell lines, such as CHO and E. coli); requires negative pressure, an autoclave and a BSC

blocks.zh: BSL-3：嚴重危害，可致命但有治療方法（如結核桿菌），需雙重門、專用排氣
blocks.en: BSL-3: serious hazard, potentially lethal but treatable (e.g. Mycobacterium tuberculosis); requires double-door entry and dedicated exhaust

blocks.zh: BSL-4：極高危害，無治療方法（如伊波拉病毒），需正壓太空衣或隔離式設施
blocks.en: BSL-4: extremely high hazard with no treatment (e.g. Ebola virus); requires positive-pressure suits or isolator-type facilities

blocks.zh: 大多數生物製藥廠運作在 BSL-1/2 級別；了解 BSL 等級是設施設計圍堵章節的先決條件。
blocks.en: Most biopharmaceutical plants operate at BSL-1/2; understanding the BSL levels is a prerequisite for the containment chapter of facility design.

blocks.zh: CNC / CNC+ — 生物製藥特有的環境分類
blocks.en: CNC / CNC+ — Environmental Classifications Specific to Biopharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: CNC（Controlled Not Classified，受控但未分級）是 ISPE Vol.6 特有的環境類型，介於一般空間（UC）與 ISO 分級潔淨室之間：
blocks.en: CNC (Controlled Not Classified) is an environment type specific to ISPE Vol.6, sitting between ordinary spaces (UC) and ISO-classified cleanrooms:

blocks.zh: 有 HVAC 控制（溫度、濕度、換氣次數），但未達 ISO 14644 的正式分級標準
blocks.en: HVAC control (temperature, humidity, air change rate) is in place, but the formal classification standards of ISO 14644 are not met

blocks.zh: 適用於封閉系統操作（如密閉管路、密閉生物反應器），因製程本身提供足夠的污染屏障
blocks.en: Suitable for closed-system operations (such as closed piping and closed bioreactors), because the process itself provides an adequate contamination barrier

blocks.zh: CNC+ 則額外加裝本地監測設備（如粒子計數器），提升環境數據可見度
blocks.en: CNC+ additionally installs local monitoring equipment (such as particle counters) to improve visibility of environmental data

blocks.zh: CHO（中國倉鼠卵巢細胞株）
blocks.en: CHO (Chinese Hamster Ovary cell line)

blocks.zh: CHO 是生物製藥業最廣泛使用的哺乳動物表達系統，約 70% 的治療性蛋白質（包括多數 MAb）由 CHO 細胞生產。了解 CHO 細胞特性（對 pH、溶氧、溫度敏感）有助於理解生物反應器設計要求。
blocks.en: CHO is the most widely used mammalian expression system in the biopharmaceutical industry; about 70% of therapeutic proteins (including most MAbs) are produced in CHO cells. Understanding the characteristics of CHO cells (sensitivity to pH, dissolved oxygen and temperature) helps in understanding bioreactor design requirements.

blocks.zh: MAb（單株抗體）— 生物製藥的旗艦產品
blocks.en: MAb (Monoclonal Antibody) — The Flagship Biopharmaceutical Product

blocks.zh: MAb（Monoclonal Antibody，單株抗體）是目前全球銷售額最高的生物製藥產品類別（包括抗腫瘤、自體免疫疾病治療藥物）。MAb 生產流程（細胞培養 → 收穫 → 蛋白A純化 → 病毒去除過濾 → 製劑）是本 ISPE Vol.6 設施設計的主要應用場景。
blocks.en: MAbs (monoclonal antibodies) are currently the highest-selling category of biopharmaceutical products worldwide (including oncology and autoimmune disease therapies). The MAb production flow (cell culture → harvest → Protein A purification → virus removal filtration → formulation) is the main application scenario for the facility design in this ISPE Vol.6.

blocks.zh: SIP vs CIP — 兩個必須區分的概念
blocks.en: SIP vs CIP — Two Concepts That Must Be Distinguished

blocks.zh: CIP（就地清洗，Clean-In-Place）：使用清洗液（NaOH、酸液等）在不拆卸設備的情況下清除污垢和殘留。目標是減少生物負荷（bioburden reduction）。
blocks.en: CIP (Clean-In-Place): uses cleaning solutions (NaOH, acids, etc.) to remove soil and residues without dismantling the equipment. The goal is bioburden reduction.

blocks.zh: SIP（就地滅菌，Steam-In-Place）：使用飽和蒸汽（通常 121°C / 15 分鐘）在不拆卸設備的情況下達到滅菌（sterile = 零生物負荷）。目標是消滅所有活微生物。
blocks.en: SIP (Steam-In-Place): uses saturated steam (typically 121°C / 15 minutes) to achieve sterilization (sterile = zero bioburden) without dismantling the equipment. The goal is to destroy all viable microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 順序：CIP 先行，SIP 其後。就像洗碗（CIP）後才能送去高壓消毒（SIP）。
blocks.en: Sequence: CIP first, then SIP. It is like washing dishes (CIP) before sending them for autoclave sterilization (SIP).

blocks.zh: 比喻：MCB vs WCB
blocks.en: Analogy: MCB vs WCB

blocks.zh: 把 MCB（Master Cell Bank，主細胞庫）想像成細胞的「原版母帶」，WCB（Working Cell Bank，工作細胞庫）是「複製品」。每次生產批次使用 WCB 的一小管，MCB 永遠作為備份保存。若 WCB 受污染，可從 MCB 重新展開（re-derive）。MCB 的保存條件和特性確認是生物製藥廠最重要的資產保護措施之一。
blocks.en: Think of the MCB (Master Cell Bank) as the "original master tape" of the cells and the WCB (Working Cell Bank) as the "copy". Each production batch uses one vial from the WCB, while the MCB is always kept as a backup. If the WCB becomes contaminated, it can be re-derived from the MCB. The storage conditions and characterization of the MCB are among the most important asset-protection measures in a biopharmaceutical plant.

blocks.zh: 12.2 Definitions — Part 1: A through C（定義：A 至 C）

blocks.zh: 原文 — Definitions: A–C

blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis — Key Terms A to C

blocks.zh: Adventitious Agents — 生物製藥的頭號風險
blocks.en: Adventitious Agents — The Number One Risk in Biopharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 外源性污染微生物（尤其是病毒，包括 TSE 朊病毒）是生物製藥安全性的核心挑戰，因為：
blocks.en: Adventitious agents (especially viruses, including TSE prions) are a core safety challenge for biopharmaceuticals, because:

blocks.zh: 原料（動物源血清、原料細胞）可能攜帶潛伏病毒
blocks.en: Raw materials (animal-derived serum, starting cells) may carry latent viruses

blocks.zh: TSE 朊病毒具有異常的抗滅菌性（一般 121°C 蒸汽滅菌無法完全消滅）
blocks.en: TSE prions are exceptionally resistant to sterilization (ordinary 121°C steam sterilization cannot fully destroy them)

blocks.zh: ICH Q5A 專門規範生物製品的病毒安全測試要求
blocks.en: ICH Q5A specifically governs the viral safety testing requirements for biological products

blocks.zh: 設施設計需包含「病毒去除/不活化步驟」（如低 pH 不活化、奈米過濾）並設置病毒隔離區域。
blocks.en: The facility design must include "virus removal/inactivation steps" (such as low-pH inactivation and nanofiltration) and provide virus segregation areas.

blocks.zh: Airborne Total Particulate — 「非活性」粒子的迷思
blocks.en: Airborne Total Particulate — The Myth of "Non-Viable" Particles

blocks.zh: 本定義特別提醒：粒子計數器無法區分活性（有菌）和非活性（無菌）粒子，因此常見的「非活性粒子計數」其實是「總粒子計數」。活性微生物監測需要另外的方法（如沉降碟、接觸碟）。這是設計環境監測計畫時必須理解的基本限制。
blocks.en: This definition specifically reminds us that a particle counter cannot distinguish viable (microbe-bearing) from non-viable (sterile) particles, so the commonly used "non-viable particle count" is really a "total particle count". Monitoring of viable microorganisms requires separate methods (such as settle plates and contact plates). This is a fundamental limitation that must be understood when designing an environmental monitoring program.

blocks.zh: Axenic State（純淨狀態）— 與 Sterile 的差異
blocks.en: Axenic State — How It Differs from Sterile

blocks.zh: Axenic（純淨）強調「只有目標生物，沒有任何污染生物」，常用於描述細胞培養或發酵過程中的理想狀態。與 Sterile（無菌）的差異：
blocks.en: Axenic emphasizes "only the target organism, with no contaminating organisms" and is often used to describe the ideal state of a cell culture or fermentation process. How it differs from Sterile:

blocks.zh: Sterile（無菌）：完全無任何活的微生物，包括目標生物
blocks.en: Sterile: completely free of any living microorganisms, including the target organism

blocks.zh: Axenic（純淨）：只有目標生物存在，無雜菌，但目標生物本身是活的
blocks.en: Axenic: only the target organism is present, with no foreign microbes, but the target organism itself is alive

blocks.zh: 發酵槽在接種後的理想狀態是 Axenic（純培養），而不是 Sterile。
blocks.en: After inoculation, the ideal state of a fermenter is Axenic (pure culture), not Sterile.

blocks.zh: Bioburden-Free（無微生物負荷）— 不等於無菌
blocks.en: Bioburden-Free — Not the Same as Sterile

blocks.zh: Bioburden-Free 的技術定義是「以現有檢測方法，生物負荷無法被偵測到」。這意味著：
blocks.en: The technical definition of Bioburden-Free is "bioburden cannot be detected with the available test methods". This means:

blocks.zh: 它是一個偵測限度的概念，而非絕對的零
blocks.en: It is a concept of a detection limit, not an absolute zero

blocks.zh: 用於描述環境（BSC 內部、RABs 內部）應達到的狀態
blocks.en: It describes the state that environments (inside a BSC or RABS) should achieve

blocks.zh: 比較保守的「功能性」說法，相對於更嚴格的「Sterile（無菌）」
blocks.en: It is a more conservative, "functional" statement, in contrast to the stricter "Sterile"

blocks.zh: 這也是為何 ISPE Vol.6 不要求所有生物製程空間都達到無菌等級，而是依照製程開放程度設計相應的環境。
blocks.en: This is also why ISPE Vol.6 does not require every bioprocess space to reach sterile grade, but instead designs the environment according to how open the process is.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Briefly Exposed 就像開蓋的鍋子
blocks.en: Analogy: Briefly Exposed Is Like a Pot with the Lid Off

blocks.zh: 「短暫暴露」就像燉湯時短暫掀蓋加料，隨後立刻蓋回（無菌過濾或熱滅菌「關閉」製程）。關鍵是：暴露時間要短、後續的密閉步驟必須充分驗證。若暴露時間太長或滅菌步驟不足以消滅潛在污染，就需要升級環境等級。
blocks.en: "Briefly exposed" is like lifting the lid for a moment to add an ingredient while simmering soup, then putting it straight back (sterile filtration or heat sterilization "closes" the process). The key points: the exposure time must be short, and the subsequent closing step must be adequately validated. If the exposure is too long, or the sterilization step is insufficient to destroy potential contamination, the environmental grade needs to be upgraded.

blocks.zh: Carryover（殘留攜帶）— 多產品廠的核心風險
blocks.en: Carryover — The Core Risk in Multiproduct Facilities

blocks.zh: 對於同時生產多種生物製品的 CDMO 而言，Carryover 是最重要的跨批次污染風險。ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.7（Risk-MaPP）提供了評估最大允許殘留量（MACO）的方法學。設計良好的 CIP 程序、適當的沖洗確效和殘留測試是管控 Carryover 的關鍵。
blocks.en: For a CDMO producing several biological products, carryover is the most important risk of cross-batch contamination. ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.7 (Risk-MaPP) provides a methodology for assessing the maximum allowable carryover (MACO). A well-designed CIP procedure, appropriate rinse validation and residue testing are the keys to controlling carryover.

blocks.zh: 導師解析 — 密閉/開放系統與 CQA/CPP
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis — Closed/Open Systems and CQA/CPP

blocks.zh: 密閉系統的三個關鍵判定條件
blocks.en: Three Key Criteria for a Closed System

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.6 的「密閉系統」定義比直覺更嚴格，必須同時滿足：
blocks.en: The ISPE Vol.6 definition of a "closed system" is stricter than intuition suggests; all of the following must be met:

blocks.zh: 設計密閉：產品永不暴露於周圍環境
blocks.en: Closed by design: the product is never exposed to the surrounding environment

blocks.zh: 操作密閉：所有進出（取樣、添加、排放）均以密閉方式進行
blocks.en: Closed in operation: all entries and exits (sampling, additions, discharge) are performed in a closed manner

blocks.zh: 確效密閉：已驗證（validated）系統能提供足夠的保護層
blocks.en: Closed by validation: the validated system provides an adequate protective layer

blocks.zh: 符合這三個條件，環境才「不是」製程的 Critical Aspect——也就是說，該空間的環境等級可以降低（如使用 CNC 而非 ISO 7/8）。
blocks.en: When all three conditions are met, the environment is "not" a Critical Aspect of the process; that is, the environmental grade of the space can be lowered (e.g. CNC instead of ISO 7/8).

blocks.zh: 密閉系統違規的後果
blocks.en: Consequences of a Closed System Breach

blocks.zh: 「若在原本密閉的系統中偵測到來自環境的污染物，即構成系統失效（system failure）。」這個定義說明了密閉系統違規（breach）的嚴重性——這不只是偏差（deviation），而是整個密閉系統設計假設的崩潰，需要徹底的根本原因調查和設計評審。
blocks.en: "If contaminants from the environment are detected in a system that was intended to be closed, this constitutes a system failure." This definition shows how serious a closed-system breach is: it is not just a deviation but the collapse of the design assumption of the entire closed system, and it requires a thorough root cause investigation and design review.

blocks.zh: 比喻：密閉系統 vs 開放系統如同保溫瓶 vs 敞口杯
blocks.en: Analogy: Closed vs Open Systems Is Like a Thermos vs an Open Cup

blocks.zh: 密閉系統就像保溫瓶：無論外界環境多髒，裡面的飲料都不受影響（只要蓋子確實蓋緊且已清潔滅菌）。開放系統就像敞口的水杯：一旦置於不乾淨的環境中，就必然受到污染風險。因此開放系統操作就必須在潔淨室（像把水杯放在極度潔淨的無塵房間）中進行。
blocks.en: A closed system is like a thermos: no matter how dirty the surroundings, the drink inside is unaffected (as long as the lid is properly sealed and the flask has been cleaned and sterilized). An open system is like an open cup: once placed in an unclean environment, it is inevitably exposed to contamination risk. Open-system operations must therefore be performed in a cleanroom (like placing the cup in an extremely clean dust-free room).

blocks.zh: CQA vs CPP — 生物製藥 QbD 的核心語言
blocks.en: CQA vs CPP — The Core Language of QbD in Biopharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 這兩個概念是 ICH Q8/Q10 品質體系的核心，也是 ISPE Vol.6 設施設計的驅動力：
blocks.en: These two concepts are at the heart of the ICH Q8/Q10 quality system and are also the driving force behind ISPE Vol.6 facility design:

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）：定義「我需要保護什麼」，例如蛋白質的糖型分佈、生物活性、純度。CQA 直接關係到患者安全。
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute): defines "what I need to protect", for example the glycoform distribution, biological activity and purity of a protein. CQAs relate directly to patient safety.

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）：定義「我需要控制什麼」，例如細胞培養的 pH、溶氧、溫度。CPP 是控制 CQA 的手段。
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter): defines "what I need to control", for example pH, dissolved oxygen and temperature in cell culture. CPPs are the means of controlling CQAs.

blocks.zh: 設施設計邏輯：CQA → 找出影響 CQA 的 CPP → 設計能有效監控和控制 CPP 的設施和系統。
blocks.en: Facility design logic: CQA → identify the CPPs that affect the CQA → design facilities and systems that can effectively monitor and control the CPPs.

blocks.zh: 一個配置了 CIP/SIP 的不鏽鋼生物反應器，是屬於 Closed、Functionally Closed 還是 Open 系統？其所在空間需要什麼環境等級？
blocks.en: Is a stainless steel bioreactor equipped with CIP/SIP a Closed, Functionally Closed or Open system? What environmental grade does the space it sits in require?

blocks.zh: 單株抗體的 CQA 可能包括哪些屬性？對應的設施設計要求是什麼？
blocks.en: What CQAs might a monoclonal antibody have? What are the corresponding facility design requirements?

blocks.zh: 為什麼說「密閉系統違規」比一般偏差更嚴重？
blocks.en: Why is a "closed system breach" considered more serious than an ordinary deviation?

blocks.zh: ISO 分級公式
blocks.en: ISO Classification Formula

C_n = 10^N × (0.1 / D)^2.08

Where:
  C_n = maximum permitted particle concentration (particles/m³)
  N   = ISO class number (1-9)
  D   = mean particle diameter (µm)

Example: ISO Class 5, 0.5 µm particles:
  C_n = 10^5 × (0.1/0.5)^2.08
      = 100,000 × (0.2)^2.08
      ≈ 3,520 particles/m³  ✓ (consistent with the table)

blocks.zh: 15-20 分鐘恢復時間 — EMA 獨有要求
blocks.en: 15-20 Minute Recovery Time — A Requirement Specific to the EMA

blocks.zh: EU GMP 要求從「動態」到「靜態」的環境恢復（recovery）時間必須在 15-20 分鐘內完成，這可透過 ISO 14644-3 的「恢復測試（recovery test）」驗證。此要求直接影響 HVAC 設計的換氣次數（ACH）和氣流速度。台灣 CDMO 若申請歐盟市場必須在確效報告中包含此測試數據。
blocks.en: EU GMP requires that environmental recovery from the "in-operation" to the "at-rest" state be completed within 15-20 minutes, which can be verified by the "recovery test" of ISO 14644-3. This requirement directly affects the HVAC design air change rate (ACH) and air velocity. A Taiwanese CDMO applying for the EU market must include this test data in its qualification report.

blocks.zh: Sterilization 方法選擇原則
blocks.en: Principles for Selecting a Sterilization Method

blocks.zh: 不同滅菌方法各有適用場景：
blocks.en: Different sterilization methods suit different scenarios:

blocks.zh: 熱滅菌（SIP, 121°C/15min）：最可靠，用於不鏽鋼設備、管路；需確效 F₀ 值
blocks.en: Heat sterilization (SIP, 121°C/15min): the most reliable; used for stainless steel equipment and piping; the F₀ value must be validated

blocks.zh: 無菌過濾（0.2µm）：用於不耐熱溶液（培養基、蛋白質溶液）
blocks.en: Sterile filtration (0.2µm): used for heat-labile solutions (culture media, protein solutions)

blocks.zh: VHP（過氧化氫蒸汽）：用於環境表面、隔離器去污；需確效殺孢效果（6-log D-value)
blocks.en: VHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide): used for environmental surfaces and isolator decontamination; sporicidal efficacy must be validated (6-log D-value)

blocks.zh: UV 輻射：用於空氣、表面；穿透力弱，僅限暴露面
blocks.en: UV radiation: used for air and surfaces; poor penetration, so limited to exposed surfaces

blocks.zh: γ 射線：用於一次性使用物品（如 SU 袋）；無法現場使用
blocks.en: Gamma radiation: used for single-use items (such as SU bags); cannot be used on site

blocks.zh: 比喻：MERV 就像口罩的過濾等級
blocks.en: Analogy: MERV Is Like the Filtration Rating of a Face Mask

blocks.zh: MERV 值就像口罩的 N 數（N95、N99）：數字越高，過濾效率越強。MERV 14/15 ≈ 95% 過濾效率，約等於一般潔淨室的 bag filter；HEPA 則是 99.97% 以上（超過 MERV 評分上限）。選擇 MERV 等級需在過濾效能和系統壓降（energy cost）之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: The MERV value is like the N rating of a mask (N95, N99): the higher the number, the greater the filtration efficiency. MERV 14/15 ≈ 95% filtration efficiency, roughly equivalent to a typical cleanroom bag filter; HEPA is 99.97% or higher (beyond the upper limit of the MERV scale). Choosing a MERV grade requires a balance between filtration performance and system pressure drop (energy cost).

blocks.zh: 一個配置 VHP 去污系統的隔離器（Isolator）內部，應達到什麼 ISO 等級？使用什麼方法確效？
blocks.en: What ISO class should be achieved inside an isolator equipped with a VHP decontamination system? What method is used to validate it?

blocks.zh: FDA 監管和 EMA 監管的廠房在環境監測方面有哪兩個主要差異？
blocks.en: What are the two main differences in environmental monitoring between FDA-regulated and EMA-regulated facilities?

blocks.zh: 使用 0.2µm 過濾器進行無菌過濾，可以去除病毒嗎？為什麼需要額外的病毒去除步驟？
blocks.en: Can sterile filtration with a 0.2µm filter remove viruses? Why is an additional virus removal step needed?

blocks.zh: ISO 分級 vs EU GMP 等級 — 雙軌體系對應
blocks.en: ISO Classification vs EU GMP Grades — Mapping the Dual Systems

blocks.zh: 全球生物製藥廠必須同時理解兩套環境分級語言：
blocks.en: Global biopharmaceutical plants must understand both languages of environmental classification:

blocks.zh: FDA vs EMA 差異：FDA 只要求在「動態（in-operation）」下測試 0.5µm 粒子；EMA/PIC/S 另外要求「靜態（at-rest）」以及 5µm 粒子的數據，且兩個狀態的轉換應在 15-20 分鐘內完成。
blocks.en: FDA vs EMA differences: the FDA requires testing only "in-operation" for 0.5µm particles; the EMA/PIC/S additionally requires "at-rest" data and 5µm particle data, and the transition between the two states should be completed within 15-20 minutes.

blocks.zh: 快速參考摘要表 — 15 個最重要術語
blocks.en: Quick-Reference Summary Table — The 15 Most Important Terms

blocks.zh: 以下 15 個術語是 ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.6 中頻率最高、最具實務影響力的核心概念，建議熟記其縮寫與一行中文定義。
blocks.en: The following 15 terms are the most frequently used and practically influential core concepts in ISPE Baseline Guide Vol.6; it is recommended to memorize their abbreviations and one-line definitions.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 — Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 附錄二的 70 個參考文獻構成一個完整的國際法規生態系統：ICH Q7/Q9/Q10/Q11 建立品質體系基礎，21 CFR Part 211 和 EU GMP Annex 1/2 設定市場准入要求，ISO 14644 系列提供環境分級技術標準，NIH/CDC 生物安全指引決定圍堵等級。
blocks.en: The 70 references in Appendix 2 form a complete international regulatory ecosystem: ICH Q7/Q9/Q10/Q11 establish the foundation of the quality system, 21 CFR Part 211 and EU GMP Annex 1/2 set the market access requirements, the ISO 14644 series provides the technical standards for environmental classification, and the NIH/CDC biosafety guidelines determine the containment level.

blocks.zh: 密閉系統（Closed System）是 Vol.6 最重要的設計概念：已驗證密閉的系統不需要高等級潔淨室（CNC 即可），但密閉違規即視為「系統失效」，需要根本原因分析。
blocks.en: The closed system is the most important design concept in Vol.6: a system validated as closed does not need a high-grade cleanroom (CNC is sufficient), but a closure breach is treated as a "system failure" and requires root cause analysis.

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）和 CPP（關鍵製程參數）是設施設計的驅動力；設施設計的本質是「建立能有效監控和保護 CPP，從而確保 CQA 的物理環境」。
blocks.en: CQAs (Critical Quality Attributes) and CPPs (Critical Process Parameters) are the drivers of facility design; the essence of facility design is "to establish a physical environment that effectively monitors and protects the CPPs, thereby ensuring the CQAs".

blocks.zh: BSL（生物安全等級）決定廠房圍堵策略的起點，這是 GMP 之外的生物安全法律義務，二者必須同時遵守。
blocks.en: BSL (Biosafety Level) is the starting point of the facility containment strategy; this is a legal biosafety obligation beyond GMP, and both must be complied with at the same time.

blocks.zh: ISO 分級（FDA：只測動態 0.5µm；EMA：測靜態+動態、0.5µm+5µm，15-20 分鐘恢復時間）的雙軌差異在進行多市場廠房確效時必須特別注意。
blocks.en: The dual-track differences in ISO classification (FDA: in-operation 0.5µm only; EMA: at-rest + in-operation, 0.5µm + 5µm, 15-20 minute recovery time) require particular attention when qualifying facilities for multiple markets.

blocks.zh: 15 個核心術語（CQA、CPP、BSL、CNC、SIP、CIP、Closed System、Axenic State、Bioburden-Free、RABS、QRM、VHP、WFI、MCB/WCB、Classified Space）是與任何監管機構溝通生物製藥廠設計的共同語言。
blocks.en: The 15 core terms (CQA, CPP, BSL, CNC, SIP, CIP, Closed System, Axenic State, Bioburden-Free, RABS, QRM, VHP, WFI, MCB/WCB, Classified Space) are the common language for communicating the design of a biopharmaceutical plant to any regulator.
